title: Nell's Fork in the Oak
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 2 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ar, or, ur
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 3, 44-sound stage (ar, or, ur just added).

pages.illustration: Nell the bee hovering beside a big old oak tree.

pages.text: Nell sees a fork in the oak.
pages.illustration: Close view of a Y-shaped fork where a branch splits on the oak tree.
Nell the bee flying up towards the branch fork on the oak tree.

pages.text: Nell did not sit on the fork.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee veering off just short of the branch fork, missing it.
Nell the bee circling back down towards the ground below the oak tree.
Nell the bee flying up towards the branch fork a second time.

pages.text: Nell did sit on the fork!
pages.illustration: Nell the bee perched neatly in the branch fork of the oak tree.

pages.text: Nell naps on the fork. Nell had fun.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee resting happily in the branch fork, eyes closed.
